arm_away.docs: This action arms the alarm in away mode. The `code` is required when *requires_code_to_arm* is *true*.

arm_home.docs: This action arms the alarm in home mode. The `code` is required when *requires_code_to_arm* is *true*.

arm_night.docs: This action arms the alarm in night mode. The `code` is required when *requires_code_to_arm* is *true*.

disarm.docs: This action disarms the alarm. The `code` is required when *codes* is not empty.

pending.docs: This action puts the alarm in pending state (the state before triggered after *pending_time*).

triggered.docs: This action puts the alarm in triggered state.

template.docs:
The `template` alarm control panel platform allows you to turn your binary sensors into a state machine managed alarm control panel.

*See also: [Template Alarm Control Panel](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel/template)*

is_armed.docs: This [Condition](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-conditions) checks if the alarm control panel is armed.

on_armed_away.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the alarm state changes to `armed_away`. See [`on_armed_away` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel#alarm_control_panel_on_armed_away_trigger).

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*

on_armed_home.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the alarm state changes to `armed_home`. See [`on_armed_home` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel#alarm_control_panel_on_armed_home_trigger).

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*

on_armed_night.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the alarm state changes to `armed_night`. See [`on_armed_night` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel#alarm_control_panel_on_armed_night_trigger).

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*

on_arming.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the alarm state changes to `arming`. See [`on_arming` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel#alarm_control_panel_on_arming_trigger).

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*

on_chime.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when a zone has been marked as chime in the configuration, and it changes from closed to open. See [`on_chime` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel#alarm_control_panel_on_chime_trigger).

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*

on_cleared.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the alarm clears. See [`on_cleared` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel#alarm_control_panel_on_cleared_trigger).

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*

on_disarmed.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the alarm state changes to `disarmed`. See [`on_disarmed` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel#alarm_control_panel_on_disarmed_trigger).

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*

on_pending.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the alarm state changes to `pending`. See [`on_pending` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel#alarm_control_panel_on_pending_trigger).

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*

on_ready.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the logical 'and' of all the zone sensors change state. See [`on_ready` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel#alarm_control_panel_on_ready_trigger).

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*

on_state.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the alarm changes state. See [`on_state` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel#alarm_control_panel_on_state_trigger).

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*

on_triggered.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the alarm triggers. See [`on_triggered` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel#alarm_control_panel_on_triggered_trigger).

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*

id.docs:
**string**: Manually specify the ID for code generation. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*

name.docs:
**string**: The name of the alarm control panel. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Alarm Control Panel Component](https://esphome.io/components/alarm_control_panel)*
